description: Persistent live dashboards — pin visuals from conversation into an interactive split-screen canvas with auto-refresh, edit mode, drag-and-drop layout, and multi-dashboard management

tool_definition.name: TDA_Dashboard
tool_definition.description: Manages live dashboards and inline visualizations. Call 'visualize' to show an auto-chart in chat. Call 'add_tile' / 'create' / 'open' / etc. for dashboard management.

content.description: Your current data answer (HTML table or text). Required for 'visualize' and 'add_tile'.

chart_type.description: Desired chart type for 'visualize': 'bar', 'column', 'line', 'pie', 'scatter'. Set when user specifies a chart type (e.g. user says 'pie chart' → 'pie'). Omit to auto-select.

dashboard_id.description: Dashboard ID. Required for 'open', 'add_tile', 'refresh' (all tiles), 'delete'. Omit for 'create' and 'list'.

name.description: Dashboard name. Required for 'create'. Should be concise and descriptive.

query.description: Data query prompt for 'add_tile'. The system will execute this query and render the result as a live dashboard tile.

tile_title.description: Concise title for the new tile (e.g. 'Revenue by Region Q2'). Required for 'add_tile' and 'visualize'.

tile_width.description: Tile width in grid columns (1–12). Default 6.

tile_height.description: Tile height in grid rows (each row ≈ 80px). Default 4.

tile_id.description: Tile ID. Required for 'refresh' when refreshing a single specific tile.

inline.description: Renders a compact dashboard card in chat (create, list, tile confirmations)

sub_window.description: Opens the dashboard split-panel canvas directly (open / close actions)
